decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds on the firm's established office furniture expertise, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the product, so keeping it is justified.
A chair family sits close to the firm's core upholstery and craftsmanship knowledge and has its own web page, so the firm can readily learn from market feedback and improve it.
Floor cushions made from carpets draw on the firm's material expertise and are presented prominently, though as a niche accessory they carry somewhat higher risk of being cut.
A soft upholstered sofa fits squarely within the firm's living-furniture competence, but it is only mentioned rather than featured on its own page, which suggests weaker commitment.
The high standing table extends the firm's conference and lounge table know-how, so it is easy to assimilate and adapt for flexible workplace settings.

The rug collection lies far from the firm's core furniture knowledge, which makes early results harder to interpret, but its own web page and its role in curated interiors argue for keeping it for now.
